model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of various models across different language families. The horizontal axis represents the language families, listed as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indo, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, while the vertical axis represents the effect, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30. Each language family has six bars, representing six models: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (green), mBERT-B2 (light red), and XLM-B2 (red). The bars have error bars indicating variability in the data. The approximate values for each model across the language families are as follows: IE-Baltic (2, 2, 5, 5, 7, 6), IE-Germanic (8, 11, 2, 2, 13, 15), IE-Indo (22, 2, 20, 12, 25, 23), IE-Romance (6, 2, 2, 3, 12, 6), IE-Slavic (6, 9, 2, 2, 16, 16), IE-other (4, 6, 2, 2, 9, 7), Isolate (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1), Semitic (12, 16, 1, 2, 13, 22), and Uralic (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2). The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart presents a comparison of the effects across different language families and models.
